## smd2: A Service Generated by Fabrica

`smd2` is a new OpenCHAMI inventory service developed using [fabrica](https://github.com/OpenCHAMI/fabrica).
It is a replacement for the older [smd service](https://github.com/OpenCHAMI/smd).

smd2 implements enough of the APIs on smd to be a drop in replacement for smd in OpenCHAMI.
The goal is to support enough of the original smd APIs,
such that exiting clients of smd do not need to change.
For example, [pcs](https://github.com/OpenCHAMI/power-control) should work with either smd or smd2.
smd2 is not 100% backward compatible with smd.

The primary way that smd2 differs from smd is that smd supports discovering nodes.
i.e. it makes the redfish calls to the Node's Management processor and collects all the information about the node.
smd2 does not do this, instead in OpenCHAMI other services or commands will do this.

The rationales for creating smd2 are as follows:
1. To be more flexible in the data that is stored. For example, to allow IDs other than xnames.
2. To support the OpenCHAMI style REST API
3. To make it easier to add new APIs and capabilities.
3. To have a service that is less complex then the current smd.
   - It does this by not bringing forward the discovery capabilities.

## Running the Service

The service can be run in multiple ways

### 1. Run in the quickstart

This shows how to run in the [quickstart guide](https://github.com/OpenCHAMI/deployment-recipes/tree/main/quickstart)

Replace the `SMD Init and Server Containers` with the following

```
###
# SMD Server Container
###
  smd:
    image: smd2:latest
    container_name: smd
    hostname: smd
    environment:
      - SMD_PORT=27779
    depends_on:
      opaal:
        condition: service_healthy
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "--fail", "--silent", "http://localhost:27779/health"]
      interval: 5s
      retries: 60
      start_period: 20s
      timeout: 10s
    networks:
      - internal
```

### 2. Run in a quadlet

This shows to how to run as a quadlet as is done in the [tutorial](https://github.com/OpenCHAMI/tutorial-2025)

Create the file `smd2.container` in `/etc/containers/systemd` with the following contents

```
[Unit]
Description=The smd container
PartOf=openchami.target

# Don’t start until its init has run:
Requires=openchami-internal-network.service openchami-jwt-internal-network.service
After=openchami-internal-network.service openchami-jwt-internal-network.service


# Don’t start until JWKS is ready:
Wants=hydra-gen-jwks.service
After=hydra-gen-jwks.service

[Container]
ContainerName=smd2
HostName=smd
Image=smd2:latest

# Environment Variables
EnvironmentFile=/etc/openchami/configs/openchami.env

# Networks for the Container to use
Network=openchami-internal.network

# Unsupported by generator options
# Proxy settings
PodmanArgs=--http-proxy=false

[Service]
Restart=always
```

### 3. Run from local source

```
make build
```
```
mkdir -p data
```
```
./bin/smd2-server serve --database-url "file:data/smd2.db?_fk=1"
```

See the learn by example section in (fabrica)[https://github.com/OpenCHAMI/fabrica?tab=readme-ov-file#-learn-by-example]

### 4. Run using docker image
```
make build image
```
```
mkdir -p data
```
```
docker run --rm --name smd2 -d -p 8080:8080 -v $(pwd)/data:/data smd2:latest
```
